Enable language detection and inspect the ISO 639-3 code returned with the document.

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(kind: 'uri', mime_type: 'text/plain', uri: 'https://example.com/text/report.txt'), { 'language_detection' => { 'detect_multiple' => false, 'enabled' => true, 'min_confidence' => 0.5 } })
puts result.results[0].detected_languages.inspect
```
